title: 人体の構造と機能及び疾病
subtitle: Human Body Structure, Function and Diseases
teachers:
IMARUOKA Toshihide
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1)	learn about psychosomatic function, body structure, and various diseases.
(2)	understand major illnesses that require psychological support.
(3)	learn about diseases that require psychological care.
(4)	learn about multi-professional collaboration in medical practice, and understand the role of a Certified Public Psychologist.
advice: Most classes will be lecture format. Because quizzes on the previous class will be held every week, students should review the contents of the current and previous class.
books: 教科書：人体の構造と機能及び疾病[医歯薬出版]
